> 第15章 修魔者（第1页）
这眼看师娘杨桃花也要被透视，眼睛突然剧痛起来。
柳大春当即闭了眼睛，有血丝流了出来。
果然这第一次使用，魔气根本跟不上，有副作用。
柳大春想着，以后要村里多采阴，把自己的魔修为提升上去。
在井底觉悟时，《伏羲阴术》当初有三大修为分支可以选择，分别是仙，魔，佛，而柳大春觉醒的正是大魔蛇锦鳞蚺，自然而然，修为之路就选择了魔。
“提高修行要多采阴。”柳大春嘀咕着。
眼下，柳大春还是先把师父埋起来的酒找出来。
柳大春想了下，这酒肯定是埋在院子里，后院，侧院都有可能，但院子那么大。
柳大春休息片刻，开启蛇瞳，往地下看去。
很快，利用透视蛇瞳的能力，就将埋在地下的酒给找了出来。
柳大春马上找来锄头，把酒给挖了出来。
整整三大酒缸，封存的非常好，没有漏风。
“傻春，这蛇和人参都是新的，酒是陈的，口子又没解封，这能骗得过去吗？”师娘杨桃花怀疑道。
“我自有办法。”柳大春卖了个关子。
接着，柳大春把人参洗干净，而蛇用活蛇，活蛇入酒才能发挥蛇酒的最大威力。
柳大春运气，使用魔气，魔气使得人参和蛇渐渐地干枯化，其植物，动物精华被一点点萃取出来，和陈酒融合在了一起。
一股浓浓的蛇酒清香飘来，如此一来陈年蛇酒就制作而成。
“师娘，酒好了，明早我就送酒到镇上的酒馆去卖。”柳大春自信地说道。

“真的可以吗？师娘总感觉不行，要不这样，你去找周婶婶，让她引个线，帮我们介绍介绍，她和酒馆的老板熟。”师娘杨桃花提议道。
这天色已经黑了下来，柳大春和师娘杨桃花吃了晚饭。
“师娘，晚上是不是和你一起睡啊？”柳大春摸着脑袋傻笑着问道。
“你不是一直都是跟师娘睡的吗？”师娘杨桃花笑着回答道。
听了这话，柳大春心中激动不已，很显然，师娘还是把自己当成了傻子。
“嗯，师娘，那我们晚上早点睡。”柳大春有些迫不及待了。
“呵呵，傻徒儿，你这是怎么了？？这么积极。”师娘杨桃花干着家务活，笑了。
“我，我想师娘了，明早还要早起把酒运镇上去呢。”柳大春说道。
“嗯，早点和师娘睡。”师娘杨桃花也没有想太多，这种事，以前也是这样的，早已经习以为常。
“师娘烧点水，洗个澡，洗干净了睡。”师娘杨桃花很淡定地说道。
“对啊，怎么了？你还不准备洗澡啊？你不洗澡师娘还要洗澡呢？”师娘杨桃花笑着说道。
“怎么了？傻徒儿，今天你怪怪的。”师娘杨桃花有一丝丝的怀疑。
“没，没，呵呵。”柳大春心里开心死了。
“嗯，你去把大木桶扛过来吧，师娘烧点温水，泡个热水澡吧。”师娘杨桃花说道。

The latest chapter of The Little Village and the Little Things_Chapter 15 The Demon Cultivator Page 1_The Little Village and the Little Things Princess Nalan_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 15 Demon Cultivator (Page 1)
Seeing that Master Yang Taohua was about to be seen through, her eyes suddenly started to hurt.
Liu Dachun immediately closed his eyes, and blood flowed out.
Sure enough, this first time I used it, the demonic energy couldn't keep up at all, and there were side effects.
Liu Dachun thought that he would like to collect more yin in the village in the future to improve his demonic cultivation.
When he awakened at the bottom of the well, "Fu Xi Yin Shu" originally had three major branches of cultivation to choose from, namely immortality, demon, and Buddha. However, Liu Dachun awakened from the great demon snake Jin-scaled Anaconda. Naturally, he chose the demon as his path to cultivation.
"To improve your practice, you need to collect more yin." Liu Dachun muttered.
At the moment, Liu Dachun had better find the wine that his master had buried first.
Liu Dachun thought for a moment, and the wine must have been buried in the yard. It was possible in the backyard or the side yard, but the yard was so big.
Liu Dachun rested for a moment, opened his snake eyes, and looked underground.
Soon, using the ability to see through snake eyes, the wine buried in the ground was found.
Liu Dachun immediately found a hoe and dug out the wine.
There are three large wine tanks, which are sealed very well and there is no air leakage.
"Si Chun, the snake and ginseng are new, the wine is old, and the seal has not been unsealed. Can this be deceived?" Yang Taohua, the master's wife, asked doubtfully.
"I have my own way." Liu Dachun gave up.
Then, Liu Dachun washed the ginseng and used live snakes for the snakes. Only when the live snakes are put into the wine can the maximum power of the snake wine be unleashed.
Liu Dachun used his luck and used demonic energy. The demonic energy gradually dried up the ginseng and snakes, and extracted their plant and animal essences little by little, and blended them with the old wine.
A strong fragrance of snake wine wafts in, and aged snake wine is made.
"Master's wife, the wine is ready. I will deliver the wine to the tavern in town to sell it tomorrow morning." Liu Dachun said confidently.
"Is it really possible? Master Wife always feels that it is not possible. Otherwise, you can go to Aunt Zhou and ask her to lead us and introduce us. She is familiar with the owner of the tavern." Master Yang Taohua suggested.
It was getting dark now, and Liu Dachun and his wife Yang Taohua had dinner.
"Master Wife, will I sleep with you tonight?" Liu Dachun asked with a silly smile while touching his head.
"Don't you always sleep with the master's wife?" the master's wife Yang Taohua replied with a smile.
After hearing this, Liu Dachun was very excited. It was obvious that the master's wife still regarded herself as a fool.
"Well, Master Wife, let's go to bed early tonight." Liu Dachun couldn't wait.
"Haha, silly disciple, what's wrong with you? You are so active." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, smiled while doing housework.
"I, I miss my wife. I have to get up early tomorrow morning to transport the wine to town." Liu Dachun said.
"Well, go to bed with Master Wife as soon as possible." Master Yang Taohua didn't think too much. This kind of thing has been like this before and she has long been accustomed to it.
"Master's wife, boil some water, take a bath, clean yourself and go to bed." Master's wife Yang Taohua said calmly.
"Yes, what's wrong? Aren't you ready to take a bath? Why don't you take a bath if you don't want to take a bath?" Yang Taohua, the master's wife, said with a smile.
"What's wrong? Silly disciple, you are acting strange today." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, had the slightest suspicion.
"No, no, haha." Liu Dachun was extremely happy.
"Well, you go and carry the big wooden barrel over. Master, please boil some warm water and take a hot bath." Master Yang Taohua said.
